description: Machine-readable headline metrics for the G1 MuJoCo entrance-test submission. Every entry is tagged with a status distinguishing how it was established.

status_legend.measured: a number computed directly from simulation/replay output
status_legend.derived: computed from other measured numbers (e.g. a ratio or count)
status_legend.human_reviewed: a human directly viewed evidence (video/frames) and made an acceptance judgment
status_legend.failed: did not meet the stated numeric target/gate, reported honestly
status_legend.not_attempted: explicitly out of scope / never started in any phase

instruction_canonical.value: Pick up the red cube and place it in the blue target area.

no_weld_attachment_teleport_or_post_rese.note: enforced in code by CubeInitGuard, tested every dataset-collection phase

nominal_success.note: deterministic 5/5 identical reruns since Phase 3C; re-confirmed live in Phase 6

setup_variant_reachable_envelope_success.note: re-confirmed live in Phase 6; was 2/3 at Phase 4B due to a since-closed placement-margin gap

setup_variant_original_five_position_cov.note: x+0.03 and y-0.03 excluded as grasp-unreachable, confirmed by pre-run IK filter and live trial agreement

human_visual_acceptance.value: prototype task completed with a documented grasp-slip limitation
human_visual_acceptance.note: Phase 4F human acceptance decision, videos artifacts/phase4f_task1_full.mp4 and artifacts/phase4f_bilateral_contact_view.mp4

strict_10mm_grasp_slip_target.note: max 3D slip while grasped, unchanged since Phase 4F, not claimed to pass

corrected_genuine_grasp_phase_slip_range.note: lift/transport/lower/release on the nominal trial, Phase 4C corrected metric

total_tests.note: re-run independently in Phase 6; see logs referenced in entrance_test_report.md Section 9

intentional_diagnostic_tests.note: assert documented, honestly-reported failing conditions (Phase4D decorative-hand static-vendor-mesh historical variant + 2 Phase 4F strict-slip-bar diagnostics), not accidental breakage

matches_intended_24_8_split.note: reported honestly per Phase 5E Section I, not resampled to force the intended split; the 24-episode BC pool itself is exactly as intended

dataset_description_qualifier.value: VLA-oriented demonstration dataset prototype with validated schema and replay instrumentation

exact_execution_max_tcp_error_m.note: max across all 29 Phase 5E episodes; mean 1.25e-6m

retreat_divergence_affects_placement_or_.note: RETREAT occurs strictly after cube release in the state machine; offenders' final placement error (1.5-4.2mm) falls inside the same range as passing episodes' (1.1-4.1mm)

description.value: Language-conditioned two-object selection: same fixed-base, torso-constrained G1 and task-local physical gripper as Task 1, extended with a second, physically-identical green cube. A privileged scripted expert receives selected_object_id from the task specification -- no learned visual-language grounding is evaluated.

reporting_language_required.value: Language-conditioned task specification with a privileged scripted expert.

selected_object_id_is_expert_metadata_no.note: selected_object_id and simulator object poses are expert/evaluation metadata; not declared as VLA policy observations

value: Pick up the red cube and place it in the blue target area.
Pick up the green cube and place it in the blue target area.

trials_per_configuration.note: three repeated deterministic executions per configuration -- no RNG anywhere in this pipeline, not distinct seeds/initial perturbations; confirmed bit-identical final_xy_target_error_m within each configuration

wrong_object_placements.note: checked every trial via distractor.in_target_xy; never true

distractor_max_displacement_range_m.note: measured as the max over every physics step from RESET through VERIFY_TASK_SUCCESS, not final-minus-initial; independently recomputed from logs/task2_language_selection.json during this audit (max 1.733mm)

distractor_displacement_metric_definitio.value: max over the entire episode of norm(distractor_xy_t - distractor_xy_initial)

onboard_camera_sees_both_objects_and_tar.note: red_pixel_fraction, green_pixel_fraction, blue_pixel_fraction all > 0 in logs/task2_language_selection.json camera_check

same_scene_instruction_swap_tested.note: arrangement A holds both cubes' poses fixed (red at slot A, green at slot B); selecting red vs. green in arrangement A is the only difference between those two configurations and each selects/places the instructed color

rejected_distractor_slot_retreat_disturb.note: an earlier, rejected 8cm-separated candidate slot (-0.08, 0.0) measured 48.7mm max distractor displacement, peaking during RETREAT; independently reproduced during this audit (48.72mm) via direct re-simulation of that candidate, confirming a real arm/gripper-sweep disturbance, not a metric or indexing bug; this candidate is excluded from the 4 final passing configurations, which use the shipped SLOT_B_OFFSET=(-0.08,-0.10) instead

verdict.note: independent audit of commit 5f119ce prior to merge; see docs/work_log.md for the audit record

full_suite_total.note: 288 pre-existing Task 1/dataset tests + 23 new Task 2 tests

full_suite_runtime_s.note: reported in reports/task2-language-selection.md Section I at commit 5f119ce; targeted re-run during this audit/merge (23 Task 2 tests + 46 Task 1 Phase 4B/4C tests) independently confirmed 0 unexpected failures without a full re-run

scaled_dataset_collection.note: one representative episode per successful configuration recorded; a full Phase-5E-scale HDF5 dataset was explicitly not required for this optional phase

task2_scaled_dataset_and_policy_integrat.note: Task 2 environment/evaluation is complete; scaled demonstration collection and policy integration for Task 2 remain not started

target_position_variation.note: would require a Task 1 scene-geometry change, proposed for a future phase, not attempted here

cube_yaw_variation.note: no pilot evidence yet that the shared controller physically grasps under yaw
